target_customer: Knowledge workers and teams who juggle many web apps in separate browser tabs
problem: Standard browsers were built for pages, not for work, so people lost time switching across dozens of web apps and tabs.
business_model: Free desktop app and browser extension aiming at future B2B SaaS subscriptions
product_category: Work browser and app launcher, team knowledge hub

founders.name: Julien Berthomier
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder and CEO. Background not found in opened sources.

founders.name: Alexandre Lachèze
founders.background_notes: Named cofounder and CTO in the VentureBeat article of 2018-05-02. Not listed on the YC page.

exit.reason: Founder post titled Handing Station to mankind, dated 2021-07-14 per search snippet, says the team decided to end the project; a SourceForge listing shows an open source version. Full post could not be fetched (403).

competitors.name: Chrome and Firefox (standard browsers)
competitors.what: General purpose browsers that Station contrasted itself with
competitors.traction_then: Dominant default way to use web apps

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on Electron and Chromium with connectors to hundreds of web apps, which was standard engineering with many integrations to maintain.

defensibility.rationale: Wrapping web apps in one window was copied by Franz, Rambox and Wavebox, and browsers could add workspaces.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Station ended in 2021 per the founder. Rivals Franz, Rambox and Wavebox were still listed in 2026 comparisons.

market_need_then: Tab sprawl across SaaS tools was a common complaint in 2018, and the product reached 400 plus supported apps according to press at the seed announcement.

branding.domain_note: Product site was getstation.com per the Medium publication slug; domain history not found.
branding.community_and_virality: Used daily by many users worldwide at shutdown according to the founder's post snippet; the product had a Product Hunt presence.

brand_strength.rationale: A very generic word that collides with radio stations and Spotify Stations in search; no brand assets found.

pivots.to: Station as automated team knowledge base (YC description)

outcome_analysis: Station raised a $3.25M seed from Accel in May 2018 after joining the W18 batch and reached many daily users, but no later round was found. The founder announced the end of the project in July 2021 and the app lives on as open source. His own explanation could not be read, so the failure factors are inferences from the lack of later funding and from free rivals, and the stated cause is not public in the sources opened.
notes: Seed confirmed by VentureBeat and tech.eu (the latter prints euros, VentureBeat dollars; Pitchbook totals $3.37M and StartupIntros $4M, unverified). Company website is not listed in the directory; the product pages are gone. The shutdown date comes from a search snippet of the founder post that could not be fetched. Competitor list is limited; Franz, Rambox and Wavebox appear only in undated or 2026 pages so are not listed.
